problem_type: Panel presentation invariants must follow the active lane owner
symptom: Retired projection fixes do not reach lane receipts or usage, and technical details can hide shot parameters.
direct_cause: Main fixed the retired V4 projection while stage4 uses laneViewModel; both technical data and shot parameters used PlanRow.detail.
class_root: Shared presentation invariants must be enforced at active receipt, usage and approval boundaries.
affected_population: All lane tools, usage values and canvas/semantic shot approvals
internal_only_reason: Restoring approved internal component behavior without a dependency or protocol change.
invariants: Undo requires successful matched receipt and declared capability support.
Context and cumulative token values use the shared compact formatter.
Semantic shot metadata stays visible while technical plan details remain collapsed.
generality_proof: Resolve model-facing tool identity before using the capability registry; both canvas nodes and semantic shots use the existing resident shot projection; lane host injects the shared token formatter.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Check capability support for every matched successful undo receipt.
Supply shared token formatting to every lane usage value.
Keep technical plan data separate from semantic shot metadata.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Tests reject undo for read-only and unknown tools even with a supplied receipt id; existing matched success stays undoable.
Host passes formatV4Tokens; migrated lane regression covers 500, 4K and 1.2M.
Lane pending regressions cover both nodes and shots; component regressions distinguish technical and metadata fields.

recurrence.reason: Any subsequent tool receipt or shot plan would hit the owner mismatch.
same_class_scan: Read lane receiptFor/tool-result and undoableLaneToolCallId to separate capability from durable receipt authority.
Read useAgentPanelV4Data labels and V4 context formatter.
Read residentPlanShots nodes and shots branches, planRowsOf technical lines and V4Intervention consumers.

prevention.invariant: Active lane owners enforce capability-aware undo and shared semantic presentation.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported tools never advertise undo; unavailable usage remains unknown.
prevention.strategy: Reuse capabilitySupportsUndo and formatV4Tokens; split technical details from visible metadata at PlanRow.

legacy_paths.rationale: Keep the retired projection deleted; carry its shared invariants into the active lane.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal presentation invariants; existing dependencies retained unchanged.

migration: No persisted data change; old transcripts with ambiguous boundaries stay visible.
residual_risks: Verification covers deterministic lane data and the current worktree browser fixture, not a newly packaged desktop application.
